representativeSnapshot.kind: isolated production-like Supabase branch required before promotion

rowCountQueries: Read-only affected-relation and per-organization row counts must be captured before execution
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: Not yet measured; execution remains blocked until preflight evidence is attached

execution.resumeStrategy: Transactional re-issue or an additive forward-fix after isolated rehearsal
execution.idempotency: Must be proven by interrupted replay in an isolated environment before promotion

quarantine.strategy: Do not infer tenant ownership; stop and quarantine unresolved rows before any backfill

constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Review locks and use expand/validate sequencing for existing relations

recovery.rollback: Prefer flag-off rollback; use an additive compensating migration for persisted schema changes
recovery.forwardFix: Ship a later additive migration after preserving unresolved records and evidence

queries: Read-only object, row-count, RLS, grant, constraint, and advisor checks must be captured
